arxiv-2109-05874.title: Function-on-function partial quantile regression
arxiv-2109-05874.creator: Ufuk Beyaztas
arxiv-2109-05874.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ufuk Beyaztas. A function-on-function linear quantile regression model, where both the response and predictors consist of random curves, is proposed by extending the classical quantile regression setting into the functional data to characterize the entire conditional distribution of functional response. In this paper, a functional partial quantile regression approach, a quantile regression analog of the functional partial least squares regression, is proposed to estimate the function-on-function linear quantile regression model.

arxiv-2206-07681.title: Learning to Accelerate Partial Differential Equations via Latent Global Evolution
arxiv-2206-07681.creator: Tailin Wu, Takashi Maruyama, Jure Leskovec
arxiv-2206-07681.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Tailin Wu, Takashi Maruyama, Jure Leskovec. Simulating the time evolution of Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) of large-scale systems is crucial in many scientific and engineering domains such as fluid dynamics, weather forecasting and their inverse optimization problems. However, both classical solvers and recent deep learning-based surrogate models are typically extremely computationally intensive, because of their local evolution: they need to update the state of each discretized cell at each time step during inference.

arxiv-2208-13776.title: Attention-based Interpretable Regression of Gene Expression in Histology
arxiv-2208-13776.creator: Mara Graziani, Niccolò Marini, Nicolas Deutschmann, Nikita Janakarajan, Henning Müller, María Rodríguez Martínez
arxiv-2208-13776.description: Abstract Interpretability of deep learning is widely used to evaluate the reliability of medical imaging models and reduce the risks of inaccurate patient recommendations. For models exceeding human performance, e.g. predicting RNA structure from microscopy images, interpretable modelling can be further used to uncover highly non-trivial patterns which are otherwise imperceptible to the human eye.

arxiv-2302-09152.title: The evolution of the UV/optical lag spectrum of NGC 7469 seen by the Liverpool Telescope Publication type: Article Type
arxiv-2302-09152.creator: F. M. Vincentelli*, M. Beard, I. Mc Hardy, E. Cackett, K. Horne, M. Pahari
arxiv-2302-09152.description: Abstract We present the results regarding the analysis of an intensive monitoring of the Active Galactic Nucleus (AGN) NGC 7469. We observed the source for 4 months with almost daily cadence in the ugriz bands, using the IO:O on the Liverpool Telescope.

arxiv-2304-05802.title: Nanocrystallites Modulate Intermolecular Interactions in Cryoprotected Protein Solutions
arxiv-2304-05802.creator: Mariia Filianina, Maddalena Bin, Sharon Berkowicz, Mario Reiser, Hailong Li, Sonja Timmermann, Malte Blankenburg, Katrin Amann-Winkel, Christian Gutt, Fivos Perakis
arxiv-2304-05802.description: Abstract Studying protein interactions at low temperatures has important implications for optimizing cryostorage processes of biological tissue, food, and protein-based drugs. One of the major challenges is related to the formation of ice nanocrystals which can occur even in the presence of cryoprotectants and can lead to protein denaturation.

arxiv-2305-04574.title: Connecting Certified and Adversarial Training
arxiv-2305-04574.creator: Yuhao Mao, Mark Niklas Müller, Marc Fischer, Martin Vechev
arxiv-2305-04574.description: Abstract Training certifiably robust neural networks remains a notoriously hard problem. While adversarial training optimizes under-approximations of the worst-case loss, which leads to insufficient regularization for certification, sound certified training methods, optimize loose over-approximations , leading to over-regularization and poor (standard) accuracy.

arxiv-2310-02512.title: Poset Associahedra and Stack-sorting
arxiv-2310-02512.creator: Son Nguyen, Andrew Sack
arxiv-2310-02512.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Son Nguyen, Andrew Sack. For any finite connected poset P P , Galashin introduced a simple convex ( | P | − 2 ) (|P|-2) -dimensional polytope 𝒜 ⁡ ( P ) \mathscr{A}(P) called the poset associahedron. For a certain family of posets, whose poset associahedra interpolate between the classical permutohedron and associahedron, we give a simple combinatorial interpretation of the h h -vector. Our interpretation relates to the theory of stack-sorting of permutations.

arxiv-2407-15421.title: Planning in a recurrent neural network that plays Sokoban
arxiv-2407-15421.creator: Mohammad Taufeeque, Philip Quirke, Maximilian Li ∗, Chris Cundy, Aaron David Tucker, Adam Gleave, Adrià Garriga-Alonso \authoremail {taufeeque,adria}@far.ai \authorinstitution FAR.AI, Berkeley, California, United States of America. ∗ Jane Street
arxiv-2407-15421.description: Abstract Planning is essential for solving complex tasks, yet the internal mechanisms underlying planning in neural networks remain poorly understood. Building on prior work, we analyze a recurrent neural network (RNN) trained on Sokoban, a challenging puzzle requiring sequential, irreversible decisions.

arxiv-2501-05108.title: Optimizing Multitask Industrial Processes with Predictive Action Guidance
arxiv-2501-05108.creator: Naval Kishore Mehta, Arvind, Shyam Sunder Prasad, Sumeet Saurav, Sanjay Singh
arxiv-2501-05108.description: Abstract Monitoring complex assembly processes is critical for maintaining productivity and ensuring compliance with assembly standards. However, variability in human actions and subjective task preferences complicate accurate task anticipation and guidance. To address these challenges, we introduce the Multi-Modal Transformer Fusion and Recurrent Units (MMTF-RU) Network for egocentric activity anticipation, utilizing multi-modal fusion to improve prediction accuracy.

arxiv-2502-02384.title: STAIR: Improving Safety Alignment with Introspective Reasoning
arxiv-2502-02384.creator: Yichi Zhang, Siyuan Zhang, Yao Huang, Zeyu Xia, Zhengwei Fang, Xiao Yang, Ranjie Duan, Dong Yan, Yinpeng Dong, Jun Zhu
arxiv-2502-02384.description: Abstract Ensuring the safety and harmlessness of Large Language Models (LLMs) has become equally critical as their performance in applications. However, existing safety alignment methods typically suffer from safety-performance trade-offs and susceptibility to jailbreak attacks, primarily due to their reliance on direct refusals for malicious queries.

arxiv-2510-19491.title: Cross-Chain Sealed-Bid Auctions Using Confidential Compute Blockchains Conference: Proceedings of the 2025 Workshop on Decentralized Finance; October 13–17, 2025; Taipei, Taiwan Proceedings of the 2025 Workshop on Decentralized Finance (DeFi ’25), October 13–17, 2025, Taipei, Taiwan DOI: 10.1145/373
arxiv-2510-19491.creator: Jonas Gebele, Timm Mutzel, Burak Öz, Florian Matthes
arxiv-2510-19491.description: Abstract . Sealed-bid auctions ensure fair competition and efficient allocation but are often deployed on centralized infrastructure, enabling opaque manipulation. Public blockchains eliminate central control, yet their inherent transparency conflicts with the confidentiality required for sealed bidding. Prior attempts struggle to reconcile privacy, verifiability, and scalability without relying on trusted intermediaries, multi-round protocols, or expensive cryptography.

arxiv-2511-07462.title: Integral Formulas for the Noncentral Tanny-Dowling Polynomials
arxiv-2511-07462.description: Abstract In this paper, we established some integral formulas for and involving the noncentral Tanny-Dowling polynomials. These formulas are shown to be generalizations of some known results on the classical geometric polynomials. Keywords: Geometric polynomial, exponential polynomial, noncentral Tanny-Dowling polynomial, noncentral Dowling polynomial 2020 MSC: 11B83, 11B73 Mahid M. Mangontarum 1 , Norlailah M. Madid 2 and Asnawi A.

pmc-10670234.title: Non-Invasive Systems Application in Traumatic Brain Injury Rehabilitation
pmc-10670234.creator: Livia Livinț Popa, Diana Chira, Ștefan Strilciuc, Dafin F. Mureșanu
pmc-10670234.description: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) is a significant public health concern, often leading to long-lasting impairments in cognitive, motor and sensory functions. The rapid development of non-invasive systems has revolutionized the field of TBI rehabilitation by offering modern and effective interventions.

pmc-10707864.title: Silicon-Based Avalanche Photodiodes: Advancements and Applications in Medical Imaging
pmc-10707864.creator: Kirill A Lozovoy, Rahaf M H Douhan, Vladimir V Dirko, Hazem Deeb, Kristina I Khomyakova, Olzhas I Kukenov, Arseniy S Sokolov, Nataliya Yu Akimenko, Andrey P Kokhanenko, Goran Kaluđerović, Nebojša Pantelić
pmc-10707864.description: Avalanche photodiodes have emerged as a promising technology with significant potential for various medical applications. This article presents an overview of the advancements and applications of avalanche photodiodes in the field of medical imaging. Avalanche photodiodes offer distinct advantages over traditional photodetectors, including a higher responsivity, faster response times, and superior signal-to-noise ratios.

pmc-11546842.title: Adunctin E from Conamomum rubidum Induces Apoptosis in Lung Cancer via HSP90AA1 Modulation: A Network Pharmacology and In Vitro Study
pmc-11546842.creator: Iksen Iksen, Natsaranyatron Singharajkomron, Hien Minh Nguyen, Hanh Nhu Thi Hoang, Duc Viet Ho, Varisa Pongrakhananon, Moon Nyeo Park
pmc-11546842.description: Lung cancer stands out as a leading cause of death among various cancer types, highlighting the urgent need for effective anticancer drugs and the discovery of new compounds with potent therapeutic properties. Natural sources, such as the Conamomum genus, offer various bioactive compounds.

pmc-12584443.title: Risk factors associated with hepatitis B virus infection among patients attending gastroenterology outpatient department at public hospitals in Northeast Ethiopia: a hospital-based unmatched case-control study
pmc-12584443.creator: Minwuyelet Maru Temesgen, Mengistu Legesse, Aklilu Feleke Haile, Birtukan Shiferaw, Tewodros Dessie, Nega Berhe
pmc-12584443.description: BackgroundHepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a major global health issue. Ethiopia is among the high endemic areas, with prevalence of infection more than 8%. However, data regarding factors associated with its acquisition in the study area is scarce. Therefore, this study aimed to explain factors associated with acquisition of HBV.

pmc-13280072.title: The Importance of Achieving High Treatment Targets in Atopic Dermatitis: A Narrative Review
pmc-13280072.creator: Antonio Costanzo, Giulia De Martino, Sara Di Fino, Luca Stingeni
pmc-13280072.description: Atopic dermatitis (AD) is associated with a significant physical, psychological, social and economic burden and a decreased quality of life. There is a relationship between disease burden and the level of disease severity and control. The burden of AD largely depends on skin lesions, itch and sleep disturbances, although other aspects also play a role.

pmc-13354056.title: Postoperative Delirium: A Survey of Perceptions Among Surgical Providers
pmc-13354056.creator: Julia R Berian, Ben L Zarzaur, Sanjay Mohanty, Farah A Kaiksow, Blair P Golden
pmc-13354056.description: BackgroundPostoperative delirium (POD) remains a significant, costly complication. Despite increasing awareness in medical specialties, understanding among surgical providers remains unknown.Objective(s)We aimed to (1) understand surgical providers’ self-perceived knowledge of and confidence in identifying and managing POD, and (2) define the perceived importance of POD among surgical providers, relative to other complications.
